headline: Manus parent Butterfly Effect completes more than $500 million funding round
headline_vi: Công ty mẹ của Manus là Butterfly Effect hoàn thành vòng gọi vốn hơn 500 triệu USD
summary: Butterfly Effect, the parent company of Chinese AI agent Manus, recently completed a new funding round of more than $500 million, the company announced on October 8.
